name: RogueStarRiver
source:
Xavier Waters, a young otter who's nearly graduated high school has roped his friend Daniel Rodriguez into going to a party with him to send off this time of his life.

Though at this party, Xavier will uncover another side to his best friend's life that he wasn't aware of.

[From [url=https://vanillabell.itch.io/rogue-star-river]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻的水獭泽维尔·沃特斯即将高中毕业。他拉上朋友丹尼尔·罗德里格斯一起参加派对，为这段人生时光画上句号。

然而，在这场派对上，泽维尔将发现挚友生活中自己从未了解的另一面。

[摘自[url=https://vanillabell.itch.io/rogue-star-river]itch.io[/url]]
